gloss: fruit vegetable; vegetable grown for its fruit (e.g., tomato, cucumber, eggplant)

definitions.gloss: fruit vegetable; vegetable cultivated for its fruit
definitions.explanation: A category of vegetables where the edible portion is the fruit of the plant, as opposed to the leaves, roots, or stems. Examples include tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, peppers, and squash.

notes:
A compound of {果|か} (fruit) and {菜|さい} (vegetable). Refers to the agricultural and botanical category of vegetables harvested for their fruit. This is a classification used in agriculture, cooking, and grocery displays.

VEGETABLE CATEGORIES:
- {果菜|かさい}: fruit vegetables — tomato, cucumber, eggplant, pepper, squash
- ⟦{葉菜|ようさい}→葉菜：20882_yousai⟧: leaf vegetables — spinach, cabbage, lettuce
- ⟦{根菜|こんさい}→根菜：13142_konsai⟧: root vegetables — carrot, daikon, potato, burdock
- ⟦{豆類|まめるい}→豆類：19500_mamerui⟧: legumes — soybeans, peas, beans

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果菜|かさい}{類|るい}: fruit vegetables (as a category)
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧{果菜|かさい}: summer fruit vegetables
- {果菜|かさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}する→栽培する：09860_saibaisuru⟧: to cultivate fruit vegetables

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根菜|こんさい}→根菜：13142_konsai⟧: root vegetables — the root-based counterpart; equally common in cooking and agriculture
- ⟦{葉菜|ようさい}→葉菜：20882_yousai⟧: leaf vegetables — the leaf-based counterpart
- ⟦{青果|せいか}→青果：14825_seika⟧: produce, fresh fruits and vegetables — a broader commercial term used in markets

USAGE:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧ (fire, conflagration), which uses entirely different kanji.
